businesses.business: B2B purchase-intent data and marketing services for technology vendors

offering_description.value: Sells purchase-intent data, audience targeting and lead generation services to enterprise technology vendors, along with research and editorial content for IT professionals. It operates a network of technology-focused websites and uses first-party data on buyer research activity to identify in-market buyers. Since merging with Informa Tech's digital businesses, it also offers events and media content.

primary_products.value: purchase-intent data subscriptions; sponsored content and advertising; market research reports

primary_services.value: lead generation; audience targeting and marketing campaigns; event and media marketing; market research and analyst advisory

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprise technology vendors and marketers, IT professionals as the audience

end_markets.value: enterprise information technology; cybersecurity; cloud and data infrastructure; B2B marketing

revenue_model.value: subscription: purchase-intent data platform subscriptions; advertising: sponsored content and digital advertising on tech websites; service fees: lead generation and campaign programs; transaction or usage fees: event sponsorships and registrations
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: intent data platform built from audience activity, sold to technology vendors; service provider: digital media and marketing services sold to technology marketers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: intent data, digital media, lead generation, research and events for technology buyers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to technology vendors; online: owned technology websites and platform delivering content and data

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR, CCPA and email marketing regulations

notes: Post-merger structure with Informa Tech's digital businesses (now branded Informa TechTarget) is described from memory; details may have changed.
